skills.description_zh:
Edge 是一个融合了两位传奇开发者思维模式的编码助手。

Edge is a coding assistant that fuses the mindsets of two legendary developers.

🧠 TJ Holowaychuk (creator of Express.js & Koa.js) minimalism: Code should be as concise as poetry, every character matters.

🚀 Guillermo Rauch (creator of Next.js & Vercel) developer-experience-first: If developers don't enjoy using it, the most powerful tool is useless.

After installation, your OpenClaw Agent transforms into Edge persona, specializing in minimal API design, full-stack development, and performance optimization. Code first, then explain "why this design".

skills.description:
MemBridge（通忆）是一个面向 AI 协同编程的项目记忆中继站。

它解决的核心问题：在 AI 开发、人类审查、AI 继续开发的循环中，
信息如何在人、AI、不同 session、不同 agent 之间无损传递。

工作方式：
1. AI 开发完 → 增量更新 SQLite 知识库（记录变更、约束、API、符号）
2. 交接给人类 → 导出审查清单（REVIEW.md）和变更摘要（CHANGELOG.md）
3. 人类确认后 → 新 AI 读 CONTEXT.md 建立心智模型，按需查询继续开发
4. 版本完成 → 导出完整项目说明书（PROJECT_SPEC.md）

三种模式：
- 开发模式：AI 直接查询 SQLite，精确拉取上下文（500 token 内定位）
- 审查模式：人类快速查看 AI 做了什么、是否踩红线
- 交接模式：完整 Markdown 文档，跨 session / agent / 团队传递

触发场景：
"项目知识库"、"AI 上下文"、"代码交接"、"版本迭代"、
"不同 AI 之间怎么共享项目信息"、"让新 AI 快速接手老项目"

skills.description: Snowflake Method novel creation master skill. Use for all long-form web novel writing workflows including: (1) Building five-layer snowflake outlines from skeleton to scene details, (2) Writing plot-unit first drafts (complete mini-events, NOT chapter-bound), (3) Splitting units into Tomato-style chapters with hooks at 1500-2500 word intervals, (4) Polishing prose without altering plot structure, (5) Managing multiple novel projects with isolated directory structures, (6) Tracking foreshadowing/recycling, (7) Routing to child skills for plot derivation and style simulation. Triggers on: novel writing, outline building, snowflake method, chapter splitting, web novel creation, plot planning, character design, pacing analysis,伏笔管理, or any long-form fiction workflow for platforms like Fanqie (Tomato).
